messages:
olivia: added a new NextStarter example (LangChain + LlamaIndex) with an eval harness. works locally but on Vercel Edge our streaming endpoint keeps reconnecting and exhausts retries. anyone seen this?

drew: quick log?

olivia: `401 while refreshing token -> retry -> stream closed` repeated, then 429. using browser/edge SDK in edge function.

sam: sounds like concurrent refreshes on auth failure. edge fetch polyfill might close the stream so the SDK spawns multiple refresh attempts. we had a single-flight refresh util for node only.

drew: workaround: switch to server SDK in SSR routes — refresh is atomic — but streaming SSE chunks stop arriving under that combo.

olivia: filed an issue with repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/912 and attached minimal app.

ci-bot: e2e job failed: next-starter-edge-streaming

sam: proposed fixes: single-flight refresh across runtimes, abort-aware retry loop, and an optional small buffer on the server to survive short auth hiccups. also add README note for edge runtime.

drew: i'll add an e2e that runs vercel dev in CI to catch this.

olivia: thanks — i'll add the buffer flag to the starter and a migration note in the README.
